name: json2dir-nix
description: JSON parsing, validation and traversal in lib.nix using only Nix builtins; a small shell launcher runs the generated filesystem operations (nix via nix-portable)
build:
# nix-portable keeps one store per user; warm up root's and nobody's (permission cases run as nobody).
{runtimes}/nix-portable/bin/nix --version && setpriv --reuid=nobody --regid=nogroup --clear-groups {runtimes}/nix-portable/bin/nix --version
